Once per Doom Quarter, use Luck in place of the Core Skill for any one Skill Check.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.59
system.summary: Once per Doom Quarter, use Luck in place of the Core Skill for any one Skill Check.

automation.note: Use to spend this Doom Quarter's use, then switch the skill to Luck in that check's roll dialog. Strike and Fear Check dialogs can't change skill: for a Strike, tick Luck under the weapon's Alternative Skills first; for a Fear Check, roll a Luck Check from your sheet and have the Director apply the result.
